title: पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Jajali warns that Tuladhara's teaching on trade and harmlessness might close the door to heaven, and Tuladhara answers by listing the true ways of dharma. He says that the sacrifice of the faithful, as of gifts offered in right faith, is what leads by the path of the gods.
summary.kn: ತುಲಾಧಾರನ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ-ಅಹಿಂಸೆಯ ಬೋಧನೆ ಸ್ವರ್ಗದ ಬಾಗಿಲು ಮುಚ್ಚಬಹುದೆಂದು ಜಾಜಲಿ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ತುಲಾಧಾರ ಧರ್ಮದ ನಿಜ ಮಾರ್ಗಗಳನ್ನು ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಶ್ರದ್ಧೆಯಿಂದ ಅರ್ಪಿಸಿದ ದಾನಗಳಂತೆ ಶ್ರದ್ಧಾವಂತರ ಯಜ್ಞ ದೇವಯಾನ ಮಾರ್ಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: जाजलि चेताता है कि तुलाधार का व्यापार और अहिंसा का उपदेश स्वर्ग का द्वार बन्द कर सकता है, और तुलाधार धर्म के सच्चे मार्ग गिनाकर उत्तर देता है। वह कहता है कि श्रद्धा से दिए दान जैसा श्रद्धावानों का यज्ञ ही देवयान मार्ग से ले जाता है।
summary.te: తులాధారుని వ్యాపారం, అహింస బోధన స్వర్గ ద్వారాన్ని మూసివేయవచ్చని జాజలి హెచ్చరిస్తాడు; తులాధారుడు ధర్మ నిజ మార్గాలను పట్టిక చేసి బదులిస్తాడు. శ్రద్ధతో అర్పించిన దానాల వలె శ్రద్ధావంతుల యజ్ఞం దేవయాన మార్గంలో చేరుస్తుందని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: துலாதாரனின் வணிகமும் அகிம்சைப் போதனையும் சொர்க்க வாயிலை மூடக்கூடும் என்று ஜாஜலி எச்சரிக்க, துலாதாரன் தர்மத்தின் உண்மை வழிகளைப் பட்டியலிட்டுப் பதிலளிக்கிறான். நம்பிக்கையுடன் அளித்த தானம் போல் நம்பிக்கையாளரின் வேள்வி தேவயான வழியில் கொண்டு செல்கிறது என்கிறான்.
summary.ml: വ്യാപാരത്തെയും അഹിംസയെയും കുറിച്ചുള്ള തുലാധരന്റെ ഉപദേശം സ്വർഗ്ഗത്തിന്റെ വാതിൽ അടച്ചേക്കുമെന്ന് ജാജലി മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകുന്നു; യഥാർത്ഥ ധർമ്മത്തിന്റെ വഴികൾ പറഞ്ഞുകൊണ്ട് തുലാധരൻ മറുപടി നൽകുന്നു. വിശ്വാസത്തോടെ അർപ്പിക്കുന്ന യജ്ഞവും ദാനവും ദേവന്മാരുടെ വഴിയിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുന്നുവെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.255; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: जाजलिरुवाच

meaning.en: Jajali said:

verses.text:
यथा प्रवर्तितो धर्मस्तुलां धारयता त्वया ।
स्वर्गद्वारं च वृत्तिं च भूतानामवरोत्स्यते ॥

meaning.en: By the dharma you have set going as you hold the scale, the door to heaven and the livelihood of beings will be blocked.

verses.text:
कृष्या ह्यन्नं प्रभवति ततस्त्वमपि जीवसि ।
पशुभिश्चौषधीभिश्च मर्त्या जीवन्ति वाणिज ॥

meaning.en: Food arises from farming, and so you too live; by animals and herbs, merchant, mortals live.

verses.text:
यतो यज्ञः प्रभवति नास्तिक्यमपि जल्पसि ।
न हि वर्तेदयं लोको वार्तामुत्सृज्य केवलम् ॥

meaning.en: You speak even of unbelief about that from which sacrifice arises. This world cannot go on by giving up livelihood and nothing else.

verses.text: तुलाधार उवाच

meaning.en: Tuladhara said:

verses.text:
वक्ष्यामि जाजले वृत्तिं नास्मि ब्राह्मण नास्तिकः ।
न च यज्ञं विनिन्दामि यज्ञवित्तु सुदुर्लभः ॥

meaning.en: I will tell you the right way, Jajali; I am no unbeliever, brahmin, nor do I scorn sacrifice, but one who truly knows sacrifice is very rare.

verses.text:
नमो ब्राह्मणयज्ञाय ये च यज्ञविदो जनाः ।
स्वयज्ञं ब्राह्मणा हित्वा क्षात्रं यज्ञमिहास्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: Homage to the brahmins' sacrifice and to those who know sacrifice. Brahmins have abandoned their own sacrifice and taken up the warrior's kind here.

verses.text:
लुब्धैर्वित्तपरैर्ब्रह्मन्नास्तिकैः संप्रवर्तितम् ।
वेदवादानविज्ञाय सत्याभासमिवानृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, it was set going by greedy, wealth-seeking unbelievers who did not understand the Vedic statements, a falsehood made to look like truth.

verses.text:
इदं देयमिदं देयमिति नान्तं चिकीर्षति ।
अतः स्तैन्यं प्रभवति विकर्माणि च जाजले ।
तदेव सुकृतं हव्यं येन तुष्यन्ति देवताः ॥

meaning.en: "This must be given, this must be given": there is no wish for an end to it. From this theft arises, Jajali, and wrongful acts. Only that is a good offering by which the gods are pleased.

verses.text:
नमस्कारेण हविषा स्वाध्यायैरौषधैस्तथा ।
पूजा स्याद्देवतानां हि यथा शास्त्रनिदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: The gods are honored by homage, oblations, recitation and herbs, as the scriptures show.

verses.text:
इष्टापूर्तादसाधूनां विषमा जायते प्रजा ।
लुब्धेभ्यो जायते लुब्धः समेभ्यो जायते समः ॥

meaning.en: From the sacrifices and works of the wicked, uneven offspring is born: from the greedy comes the greedy, from the balanced the balanced.

verses.text:
यजमानो यथात्मानमृत्विजश्च तथा प्रजाः ।
यज्ञात्प्रजा प्रभवति नभसोऽम्भ इवामलम् ॥

meaning.en: As the sacrificer is, so are the priests, and so are the people; from sacrifice creatures arise, like pure water from the sky.

verses.text:
अग्नौ प्रास्ताहुतिर्ब्रह्मन्नादित्यमुपतिष्ठति ।
आदित्याज्जायते वृष्टिर्वृष्टेरन्नं ततः प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: The oblation cast into the fire, brahmin, reaches the sun; from the sun comes rain, from rain food, and from that creatures.

verses.text:
तस्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात्पूर्वे सर्वान्कामांश्च लेभिरे ।
अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी आशीर्भिर्वीरुधोऽभवन् ।
न ते यज्ञेष्वात्मसु वा फलं पश्यन्ति किंचन ॥

meaning.en: By rightly performed sacrifice the ancients obtained all desires. The earth yielded without ploughing, and plants grew through blessings. They saw no fruit for themselves in sacrifices.

verses.text:
शङ्कमानाः फलं यज्ञे ये यजेरन्कथंचन ।
जायन्तेऽसाधवो धूर्ता लुब्धा वित्तप्रयोजनाः ॥

meaning.en: Those who sacrifice doubting its fruit, however they do it, become unrighteous, cheats, greedy, wealth-seekers.

verses.text:
स स्म पापकृतां लोकान्गच्छेदशुभकर्मणा ।
प्रमाणमप्रमाणेन यः कुर्यादशुभं नरः ।
पापात्मा सोऽकृतप्रज्ञः सदैवेह द्विजोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: He would go to the worlds of sinners by his evil act, the man who does wrong by taking the false for the true; that sinful, unwise one, best of the twice-born, is forever so.

verses.text:
कर्तव्यमिति कर्तव्यं वेत्ति यो ब्राह्मणोभयम् ।
ब्रह्मैव वर्तते लोके नैति कर्तव्यतां पुनः ॥

meaning.en: The brahmin who knows both what is to be done and that it is "to be done" lives in the world as Brahman itself and does not come again to that duty.

verses.text:
विगुणं च पुनः कर्म ज्याय इत्यनुशुश्रुम ।
सर्वभूतोपघातश्च फलभावे च संयमः ॥

meaning.en: We have heard that action done without the proper qualities may be greater still; it includes the harming of no being and restraint concerning fruit.

verses.text:
सत्ययज्ञा दमयज्ञा अलुब्धाश्चात्मतृप्तयः ।
उत्पन्नत्यागिनः सर्वे जना आसन्नमत्सराः ॥

meaning.en: Men of truth-sacrifice and self-control sacrifice, free of greed, content in the self, giving up what they have gained, were all near to being without envy.

verses.text:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञतत्त्वज्ञाः स्वयज्ञपरिनिष्ठिताः ।
ब्राह्मं वेदमधीयन्तस्तोषयन्त्यमरानपि ॥

meaning.en: Knowers of the field and the knower of the field, fully devoted to their own sacrifice, reciting the Vedas of Brahman, they pleased even the immortals.

verses.text:
अखिलं दैवतं सर्वं ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणसंश्रितम् ।
तृप्यन्ति तृप्यतो देवास्तृप्तास्तृप्तस्य जाजले ॥

meaning.en: All divinity, Brahman entire, rests in the brahmin. The gods are pleased when he is pleased, and satisfied when he is satisfied, Jajali.

verses.text:
यथा सर्वरसैस्तृप्तो नाभिनन्दति किंचन ।
तथा प्रज्ञानतृप्तस्य नित्यं तृप्तिः सुखोदया ॥

meaning.en: As one sated with all savors cares for nothing more, so for one satisfied with knowledge there is always a satisfaction that brings happiness.

verses.text:
धर्मारामा धर्मसुखाः कृत्स्नव्यवसितास्तथा ।
अस्ति नस्तत्त्वतो भूय इति प्रज्ञागवेषिणः ॥

meaning.en: Delighting in dharma, happy in dharma, resolved on the whole, seekers of wisdom, saying "there is yet more to us in truth,"

verses.text:
ज्ञानविज्ञानिनः केचित्परं पारं तितीर्षवः ।
अतीव तत्सदा पुण्यं पुण्याभिजनसंहितम् ॥

meaning.en: some versed in knowledge and wisdom, wishing to cross to the farther shore: that is always very holy, and joined to the family of the holy.

verses.text:
यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति न च्यवन्ति व्यथन्ति च ।
ते तु तद्ब्रह्मणः स्थानं प्राप्नुवन्तीह सात्त्विकाः ॥

meaning.en: Having gone there, they neither grieve nor fall nor suffer. These pure ones here reach that abode of Brahman.

verses.text:
नैव ते स्वर्गमिच्छन्ति न यजन्ति यशोधनैः ।
सतां वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते यथाबलमहिंसया ॥

meaning.en: They do not wish for heaven and do not sacrifice with costly wealth. They follow the path of the good, as far as they can, without harm.

verses.text:
वनस्पतीनोषधीश्च फलमूलं च ते विदुः ।
न चैतानृत्विजो लुब्धा याजयन्ति धनार्थिनः ॥

meaning.en: They know trees, herbs, fruits and roots; and greedy priests who want money do not make them perform sacrifice.

verses.text:
स्वमेव चार्थं कुर्वाणा यज्ञं चक्रुः पुनर्द्विजाः ।
परिनिष्ठितकर्माणः प्रजानुग्रहकाम्यया ॥

meaning.en: Doing their own work, the twice-born again performed sacrifice, their rites complete, wishing to favor creatures.

verses.text:
प्रापयेयुः प्रजाः स्वर्गं स्वधर्मचरणेन वै ।
इति मे वर्तते बुद्धिः समा सर्वत्र जाजले ॥

meaning.en: They would lead creatures to heaven by following their own dharma. So my judgment stands, even toward all, Jajali.

verses.text:
प्रयुञ्जते यानि यज्ञे सदा प्राज्ञा द्विजर्षभ ।
तेन ते देवयानेन पथा यान्ति महामुने ॥

meaning.en: By what the wise always use in sacrifice, best of the twice-born, they go by the path of the gods, great sage.

verses.text:
आवृत्तिस्तत्र चैकस्य नास्त्यावृत्तिर्मनीषिणाम् ।
उभौ तौ देवयानेन गच्छतो जाजले पथा ॥

meaning.en: For one there is return there; for the thoughtful there is no return. Both go by the path of the gods, Jajali.

verses.text:
स्वयं चैषामनडुहो युज्यन्ति च वहन्ति च ।
स्वयमुस्राश्च दुह्यन्ते मनःसंकल्पसिद्धिभिः ॥

meaning.en: For them, oxen yoke themselves and carry, and cows give milk on their own, through fulfillment of the mind's resolve.

verses.text:
स्वयं यूपानुपादाय यजन्ते स्वाप्तदक्षिणैः ।
यस्तथाभावितात्मा स्यात्स गामालब्धुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: They take up the sacrificial posts themselves and sacrifice with well-earned gifts. One whose self is so perfected may deserve to offer the cow.

verses.text:
ओषधीभिस्तथा ब्रह्मन्यजेरंस्ते नतादृशाः ।
बुद्धित्यागं पुरस्कृत्य तादृशं प्रब्रवीमि ते ॥

meaning.en: Others, not of that kind, sacrifice with herbs, brahmin; I tell you of such, putting renunciation of intellect first.

verses.text:
निराशिषमनारम्भं निर्नमस्कारमस्तुतिम् ।
अक्षीणं क्षीणकर्माणं तं देवा ब्राह्मणं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: The gods know as a brahmin one without blessings, without undertakings, without salutations or praise, unexhausted though his deeds are exhausted.

verses.text:
नाश्रावयन्न च यजन्न ददद्ब्राह्मणेषु च ।
ग्राम्यां वृत्तिं लिप्समानः कां गतिं याति जाजले ।
इदं तु दैवतं कृत्वा यथा यज्ञमवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: One who neither recites, nor sacrifices, nor gives to brahmins, but seeks a village livelihood, what goal does he reach, Jajali? Yet, making this a deity, he may gain the sacrifice.

verses.text: जाजलिरुवाच

meaning.en: Jajali said:

verses.text:
न वै मुनीनां शृणुमः स्म तत्त्वं
पृच्छामि त्वा वाणिज कष्टमेतत् ।
पूर्वे पूर्वे चास्य नावेक्षमाणा
नातः परं तमृषयः स्थापयन्ति ॥

meaning.en: We do not truly hear the sages' truth. I ask you this hard thing, merchant. The earlier ones, not looking to it, and the sages after this do not fix anything beyond it.

verses.text:
अस्मिन्नेवात्मतीर्थे न पशवः प्राप्नुयुः सुखम् ।
अथ स्वकर्मणा केन वाणिज प्राप्नुयात्सुखम् ।
शंस मे तन्महाप्राज्ञ भृशं वै श्रद्दधामि ते ॥

meaning.en: In this very self-shrine animals cannot find happiness. By what deed of his own then can one find happiness, merchant? Tell me that, O very wise one; I have great faith in you.

verses.text: तुलाधार उवाच

meaning.en: Tuladhara said:

verses.text:
उत यज्ञा उतायज्ञा मखं नार्हन्ति ते क्वचित् ।
आज्येन पयसा दध्ना पूर्णाहुत्या विशेषतः ।
वालैः शृङ्गेण पादेन संभवत्येव गौर्मखम् ॥

meaning.en: Whether they sacrifice or do not, they never merit a sacrifice. With clarified butter, milk, curds and especially a full oblation, even by hair, horn or hoof the cow becomes the sacrifice.

verses.text:
पत्नीं चानेन विधिना प्रकरोति नियोजयन् ।
पुरोडाशो हि सर्वेषां पशूनां मेध्य उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: By this rule one makes the wife take part, appointing her. The cake offering is called the pure one of all animals.

verses.text:
सर्वा नद्यः सरस्वत्यः सर्वे पुण्याः शिलोच्चयाः ।
जाजले तीर्थमात्मैव मा स्म देशातिथिर्भव ॥

meaning.en: All rivers are the Sarasvati, all rock-heaps are holy. Jajali, the self alone is the holy place; do not be a guest from place to place.

verses.text:
एतानीदृशकान्धर्मानाचरन्निह जाजले ।
कारणैर्धर्ममन्विच्छन्न लोकानाप्नुते शुभान् ॥

meaning.en: Practicing such dharmas here, Jajali, one who seeks dharma through reasons does not gain happy worlds.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एतानीदृशकान्धर्मांस्तुलाधारः प्रशंसति ।
उपपत्त्या हि संपन्नान्नित्यं सद्भिर्निषेवितान् ॥

meaning.en: Tuladhara praised such dharmas, ever followed by the good and perfected by reasoning.
